Game Overview

In Alien Color Race, the core idea is straightforward: leap into the cosmic chaos of Alien Color Race. Maneuver your alien to expand territory and outlast rivals in a vibrant, fast-paced battle of wit and reflexes. Quick strategy and nimble action are your keys to victory. Can you claim the arena and emerge victorious as the last alien standing?
